title: Daily report approvals
hint: Late submissions, edits after the deadline, and paid leave beyond the remaining balance. Tap one to check the before/after and approve or send it back.

kindNote.edit: Approving replaces the daily report with this content and it counts toward totals and pay.
kindNote.late_new: This report was submitted after the deadline. Approving registers it and it counts toward totals and pay.
kindNote.paid_leave_over: Paid leave on a day without enough remaining balance. Approving registers it as paid leave.

dualTwo: Takes effect once both the site manager and the owner approve
dualOwnerOnly: Takes effect once the owner approves
partialNote: Your approval alone won't update the report ({role} still needs to approve).
mine: You can't approve your own request. Ask another approver.
notYourTurn: This request isn't yours to approve (waiting for the other approver).
rejectHint: The reason is sent to the worker's notifications. They can fix it and resubmit.
rejectNotePlaceholder: e.g. Wrong site. Please choose the correct site and resubmit.
approvedDone: Approved. The daily report has been updated.
partialDone: Approved. {role} still needs to approve before it takes effect.

err.not_an_approver: You don't have permission to approve.
err.not_an_approver_for_this: You can't approve this request (the site manager or the owner approves it).
err.self_approval_forbidden: You can't approve your own request. Ask another approver.
err.pending_not_found: This request wasn't found (it may have been withdrawn).
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
